title: Cheese and Mushroom Burekitas
subtitle: with a kashkaval sour cream pastry
description: Small rectangular pastries of kashkaval and sour cream dough filled with slow-cooked porcini and button mushrooms. The filling makes enough for half the dough.

steps.text: Place the flour, salt and cold butter in a mixer with the paddle attachment and mix to crumbs. Add the sour cream and mix to a dough. Add the grated kashkaval and mix until even. Flatten by hand to a rectangle about 2 cm thick, wrap in cling film and refrigerate for 2 hours.
Soak the porcini in 1/2 cup boiling water for about 10 minutes.

Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a medium pot and fry the finely chopped onion over medium heat for 5 minutes until golden. Add the finely chopped button mushrooms, the porcini and 3-4 tablespoons of the soaking liquid, and season with salt, pepper and thyme leaves. Cook about 5 minutes until the sauce reduces. Taste and adjust seasoning. Add the butter while stirring and cook for about 20 minutes over medium-high heat until the liquid has almost completely reduced. Cool.
Preheat the oven to 200°C and line 2 trays with baking paper.

Divide the dough into 2 parts and roll one part out on a floured surface to 2 mm thick. Cut 5 cm squares with a pizza cutter or sharp knife. Place a teaspoon of mushroom filling in the centre of each, fold into a rectangle and press the edges together firmly. Arrange on the tray, brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with nigella seeds or sesame seeds.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until lightly golden.
